Subject: Request to combine QBR + roadmap demo into one session

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — as we pull together the Q4 renewal cadence I wanted to ask whether we can consolidate the Renewal QBR and the roadmap demo into a single 90-minute session. Our execs are stretched and it would be easier to block one focused meeting rather than two separate windows.

Preferable windows from our side are:
- Tue Nov 9, 15:00–16:30 ET
- Wed Nov 10, 14:00–15:30 ET

If those don’t work we can take a 60-min exec-level walkthrough + 30-min technical breakout (smaller group) on a different day.

I’ve attached a brief stakeholder list and current priorities to help you scope the agenda. Can you propose internal availability and confirm whether you can run the demo from a staging environment so we can show an end-to-end flow?

Thanks,
Elena Rios
Head of Product Operations
ClearWave Health

[Attachment: stakeholder_list.csv (CSV)]

- Staging demo: yes, we can run from our staging cluster and reserve an isolated demo instance so there are no cross-tenant effects. Diego will lead the environment prep.
- Agenda: propose 60 minutes for the executive roadmap + 30 minutes for the technical breakout with product and infra deep-dive.

Candidate slots from our side (all ET):
- Tue Nov 9, 15:00–16:30 
- Thu Nov 11, 13:00–14:30
- Mon Nov 15, 11:00–12:30

If the first slot on Nov 9 works we’ll: 1) lock the recording and executive packet; 2) run a 30-minute dry run internally two days prior; 3) include a short appendix for compliance / SOC2 items in the exec packet.

I’ve looped in Jonas (renewal lead) and Diego (demo infra). If Nov 9 is the call they mentioned, we’ll need a confirmed attendee list by Nov 4 to finalize the packet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
